t: This is the West India Quay Footbridge, a pedestrian bridge across the North Dock in Canary Wharf. It was designed by two architects, Jan Kaplický, the Czech architect and designer, and Amanda Levete. Levete was a partner at Future Systems when the firm won the 1999 Stirling Prize for its Lord's Media Centre, and she was later appointed CBE in 2017. It's a modern crossing, and a good spot to look out over the dock and the towers beyond.
